game.title: Might and Magic: Secret of the Inner Sanctum

shots.caption: "Licensed by Nintendo" at power-on
Copyright page: American Sammy, New World Computing 1987, G-Amusements 1991
Title: Might and Magic, star field, Continue / New Game
New Game: the owl flies in before Sorpigal
"Welcome to our town Sorpigal." - the townsman greets the new hero
"What is your name?": RYZ typed on the scrolling letter row
First control: Sorpigal street, "GO AHEAD FIGHTERS!"
Sorpigal: sign above the door "B AND B BLACKSMITHS" (second Left is eaten by the sign)
Inn of Sorpigal: the innkeeper asks "Would you like to sign in?"
Signing in saves: "Push A button and save your adventure."
Inn menu: Member, Rest, View, Cancel
Inn > Member > Add: "Select your fellows", roster with class/race card
Inn: the party of six RYZ KN, CONDI PA, EBO CL, CUBI RO, DEDDO WI, MNZ AR
Exploration menu: Search Cast Open Use Row View Camp Prot Speed Cancel + party
Automap (Select) of a well explored Sorpigal: walls, doors, shops; grey = not yet visited; arrow = party
View, page 1: RYZ, human Knight, age 17, level 1, good, experience, condition
View, page 2: the seven statistics (Intellect, Might, Personality...) and armour class
View, page 3: EBO (Cleric) HP 5/5, magic points 10/10 at spell level 1, gems, gold, food
B and B Blacksmiths: "A man speaks: Can I help you?"
Blacksmith menu: Buy, Sell, View, Cancel, with the party list
B and B Blacksmiths, Buy > Weapon: Dagger, Hand Axe, Short Sword, Sling, Crossbow, Staff
Blacksmith: "It's 20 Gold. OK?" for a Short Sword
Blacksmith, Buy > Armor: Small Shield, Padded, Leather, Scale Armor, Ring Mail, Chain Mail
View, backpack: RYZ carries a Club, the new Short Sword and Scale Armor
Camp: "Rest here?" (resting heals, costs food, may bring a night attack)
Camp, declining to rest: the item menu Equip, Remove, Trade, Drop, Share
View, equipped items: RYZ wields the Short Sword and wears the Scale Armor
Eulard's Fine Foods: "Would you like to buy some Food?"
Market (Eulard's Fine Foods): "Food price is 5 Gold. Will you pay?"
Temple of Sorpigal: "Do you seek our help?"
Temple ("House"): Help (healing, uncurse), Donate, View
Otto's Training: "Do you require training?"
Training: "RYZ, you need 1500 Exp for next Level"
Training complete: "Welcome to Level 2!" (40 gold)
Guild of Sorpigal: the guild master offers Change, Rename, View
Guild, Change class: "You must abandon all your experience..."
Tavern of Sorpigal: Drink, Tip, Rumors, View, Cancel
Tavern rumour: "All Portals are connected."
The leprechaun of Sorpigal: "Only 1 Gem you lose..." (teleport to another town)
Encounter in Sorpigal: two Goblins and two Skeletons; Attack, Bribe, Run, Giveup
RYZ's orders: Auto, Fight, Block, Row, Use, View, Prot, Run (Cast greyed for a Knight)
Fight > Which?: targets with hit points (Goblin 9, Goblin 7, Skeleton 9, Skeleton 8)
Combat message: Goblin attacks 1 time, hits 1 time, 1 point of damage
DEDDO casts: Mage Spell levels 1-7
Mage spells, level 1: Awaken, Detect, Voice, Flame, Armor, Light, Locate, Sleep
Sorpigal Cavern (C-SORPIGAL): blue cave walls
Sorpigal Cavern: "A shimmering blue and white Portal appears! Enter?"
RYZ attacks a Wolverine: 3 times, hit 2 times, damaged 12 points, "Monster goes down"
EBO's Cleric spells, level 1: Awaken, Aim, Blind, Cure1, Light1, Cure3, P-Fear, Bless1
DEDDO casts Flame: "Savage Shrew damaged 3Pts" (spells work in the cavern)
Victory in the Sorpigal Cavern: "Each survivor receives 300 EXP"
After the fight, Search: "Member found a chest"
Treasure chest: Open, Untrap, Detect, Cancel
Chest trap: "BLADES!! Sharp blades slice through the party!"
Chest loot: "RYZ gets an item" (twice)
A member falls: "hit 2 times, damaged 20Pts, CONDI goes down"
"MNZ is paralyzed! MNZ dies!" - the last fighter falls
Game over: "The Shadow of Death has fallen upon your Party!"
Portsmith: red stone streets
Algary: green stone streets
Dusk: purple stone town
Erliquin: orange stone town
VARN outdoors, sector A2: red mountains and forest
VARN sector B3: forest and a lake
VARN B3 lake shore: "Cannot swim!"
VARN sector C4: yellow-leaved forest
VARN sector D1: mountains in the orange desert
VARN D1 desert: "It's hot... You're lost!!!"
VARN sector E4: coast with sea and grey mountains
Cave below Dusk (CAVE DUSK): blue rock tunnels
Volcano: a stone hall with a blue floor
Castle Doom: golden halls
Castle White Wolf (CASTLE WW)
Castle Blackridge North (CASTLE BN)
Castle Dragadune: blue stone halls
Enchanted Forest, first level (ENCHANT B1)
City of Gold, first level (P-PEEK1)
Castle Alamar: red-floored golden halls
Castle Alamar throne room: "The omnipotent King Alamar speaks:"
The false king: "Varnlings, I quest thee to find the Crypt of Carmenca. Away with you..."
With the Eye of Goros: "You've discovered my true identity! Into the soul maze you go..."
Soul Maze: "A strange alien being in a shimmering silver jumpsuit proclaims:"
"To escape, you must find your captor's name hidden within these walls."
Soul Maze: the last labyrinth
Soul Maze answer: the captor's name SHELTEM typed on the letter row
Answer accepted: "Imposter xx21a7-3 voided!"
"You are now Rank 1 and eligible for transfer."
Astral Plane, once the impostor is voided: "Message: My dream leads me, your dream leads you."
Inner Sanctum: "The metallic room is dimly lit by a pulsating white glow!"
The Data Keeper: "Welcome to your Inner Sanctum."
"You are given the opportunity for transfer to another World."
"...+500,000 exp for your accomplishment!"
"A metallic panel slides open, revealing..." - then the party is back in Sorpigal
